Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the candid discussion on your latency and compliance requirements for the recommendation feature.

Attached is the pricing deck (v3) and an estimated consumption worksheet tailored to the usage profile you shared. Highlights:

- Monthly estimate (consumption + reserved baseline): $28,500 — detailed line items in the worksheet
- Suggested pilot: 4-week proof-of-value with traffic mirroring, followed by a capacity commit

2) If the estimate looks good, book a 30-min walkthrough with Monica for the billing/ops details
